entity.description: A Prometheus-text endpoint that scrape#Targets reads into otel_metrics each intervalSeconds.

field.name: url
field.description: http or https URL of the exposition, such as http://host:9100/metrics

field.name: serviceName
field.description: service.name of the scraped metrics; the URL's host:port when empty

entity.description: An HTTP request run#Checks makes each intervalSeconds, recorded as a root span with the request as its child.

field.name: method
field.description: GET (default), HEAD or POST

field.name: expectStatus
field.description: 200 when empty

entity.description: A lease on a scope (the regression detector, an incident's recovery), so one server works on it at a time. A claim is a conditional update of claimToken and claimedUntil.

field.name: claimedUntil
field.description: Epoch milliseconds

entity.description: The stats of a service version over a window, kept so a comparison does not change as raw telemetry ages out.

field.name: baselineKind
field.description: version (the previous version before a release) or historical (the same version a day earlier)

field.name: statsJson
field.description: requests, errors, operation runs and rollbacks, latency bounds and buckets, minutes covered, telemetry lost

field.name: metric
field.description: error_rate, latency_p95 or rollback_rate

field.name: magnitude
field.description: The candidate value over the baseline value (a ratio)

field.name: confidence
field.description: 1 less the one-sided p-value of the comparison

field.name: severity
field.description: major or critical

field.name: dataQuality
field.description: good or degraded

field.name: locality
field.description: version (every instance of the version), instance (some instances while others of the version are healthy) or unknown

field.name: affectedInstances
field.description: Comma-separated instance ids

field.name: statusId
field.description: Open, Resolved or Dismissed

field.name: severity
field.description: minor, major or critical

field.name: statusId
field.description: Open, Mitigating, Monitoring, Resolved or Reopened

field.name: source
field.description: regression, alert or user

field.name: causeStatus
field.description: unknown, hypothesis or confirmed

entity.description: One row of an incident's timeline.

field.name: kind
field.description: release, config, deploy, regression, alert, error, trace, missing, note, decision, action or verification

field.name: refId
field.description: The regression, annotation, error group, trace or action it is about

entity.description: A ranked probable cause, with its supporting and contradicting evidence. A hypothesis until an operator confirms or rejects it.

field.name: kind
field.description: release, change, instance, dependency or error

field.name: statusId
field.description: hypothesis, confirmed or rejected

entity.description: Which incidents a policy applies to, the actions it may take, least disruptive first, and how: advisory (the default) records the recommendation, approval waits for a MONITOR_RECOVER approval, automatic runs it when telemetry/recovery allow-automatic is true. The first enabled policy that matches an incident applies.

field.name: serviceName
field.description: A regular expression on the incident's service; empty for any

field.name: minSeverity
field.description: minor, major (default) or critical

field.name: mode
field.description: advisory, approval or automatic

field.name: ladderJson
field.description: The actions in order, each {action, target, adapterId}: observe, escalate, pause-job (target: jobName), pause-alert-rule (target: alert definitionId), disable-artifact (target: artifactGroupId), isolate-instance (the incident's instance), pause-rollout, restart, rollback (to the version before) or promote

field.name: adapterId
field.description: The adapter of steps that name none

field.name: contactJson
field.description: Where escalations go: a contact point as alert rules have them; a notification to the ADMIN group when empty

field.name: minConfidence
field.description: The least regression confidence for an action beyond observe and escalate; 0.99 when empty

field.name: maxRollbackRate
field.description: The operation rollback rate over which business health fails verification; 0.05 when empty

entity.description: How actions are carried out: in-process (pause-job, pause-alert-rule, disable-artifact, isolate-instance, escalate), webhook (a signed POST to a deployment controller, which reports back on /v1/recovery or through statusUrl) or manual (an operator does it and marks it done).

field.name: adapterType
field.description: in-process, webhook or manual

field.name: urlProperty
field.description: A server property holding the URL, in place of url

field.name: statusUrl
field.description: Polled with the action id for its status, when the controller does not call back

field.name: secretProperty
field.description: A server property holding the HMAC-SHA256 key the request body is signed with (X-Moqui-Signature)

field.name: headerPropertiesJson
field.description: Header name to server property name

field.name: allowInternal
field.description: Y lets the webhook reach private and loopback addresses, as a controller inside the cluster is; set only by MONITOR_RECOVER_ADMIN

field.name: instructions
field.description: What an operator does, for a manual adapter

field.name: statusId
field.description: Proposed (advisory), AwaitingApproval, Approved, Refused, Blocked or Superseded

field.name: blockedReason
field.description: Why automation stopped, when nothing beyond escalation was allowed

field.name: rationaleJson
field.description: Each step considered and why it was taken or not

field.name: decisionHash
field.description: What an approval is bound to; a changed incident makes a new decision and supersedes this one

entity.description: An action, persisted before it runs, with one active action per scope.

field.name: leaseToken
field.description: The scope lease the action holds while it is active

field.name: statusId
field.description: Persisted, Running, AwaitingOperator, Succeeded, Failed, TimedOut, Cancelled or Reverted

field.name: undoJson
field.description: What reverting the action restores

field.name: verificationStatus
field.description: Verified, Failed or Inconclusive

field.name: result
field.description: Verified, Failed or Inconclusive

entity.description: The emergency stop: while stopped, no recovery action runs or starts; decisions still record what would be done.
Whether an instance is drained (isolate-instance): it answers /health with 503 and draining, and still serves the requests that reach it.
